charters.name: Standard
charters.describe: The game as it is: two lines, three regions, the playoffs.

charters.name: Iron line
charters.describe: One line and no bench: the same three skaters play every minute of every game. They tire 35% more slowly.

charters.name: Bruisers
charters.describe: Every body check that lands, by either side, puts its man on the ice. Your checks are 15% stronger.

charters.name: Blue-line club
charters.describe: Each goal by one of your defencemen makes the whole team 1% faster for the rest of the season, up to 10%. Your shots are a little weaker throughout.

charters.name: Short season
charters.describe: One region and its boss, then the playoffs. Games pay 25% fewer Pucks.

charters.name: Showmen
charters.describe: A club that lives on its tricks. You start with three more powerups and shops are 25% cheaper, but your goalie covers 6% less net.

charters.name: Collectors
charters.describe: One more artifact to choose from every time, and one fewer strike before the season is over.

vows.name: Stronger opponents
vows.describe: Every opponent is 2 points better at everything, for each rank.

vows.name: Sharper opponents
vows.describe: Every opponent thinks faster and makes fewer mistakes, for each rank.

vows.name: Dear shops
vows.describe: Everything in a shop, strike repairs included, costs 30% more for each rank.

vows.name: Thin ice
vows.describe: One fewer strike before the season is over.

vows.name: Every game counts
vows.describe: No game can be simulated: you play them all.

vows.name: Slim pickings
vows.describe: One fewer artifact to choose from each time.

vows.name: No repairs
vows.describe: Shops do not wipe strikes. Only beating a boss does.

vows.name: Bare cupboard
vows.describe: You start the season with no powerups.
